paragraphs: As an Architecture student at Ain Shams University, I'm driven by design, creativity, and exploration. Beyond academics, I engage in student activities and competitions, honing teamwork, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Beyond Architecture learning
I find inspiration in wandering the streets of Egypt, observing the layers of history, culture, and everyday life that shape the built environment. This exploration has deepened my appreciation for architecture and fueled my love for photography, allowing me to capture the essence of spaces and their stories.
